title: Ambient complete rational and algebraically closed coefficient categories
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, write $\Ql=\mathbf Q_\ell$, fix an algebraic closure $\Qlb$, and use the directed set $\mathsf{FinExt}_\ell$ of finite intermediate extensions [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set]. Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $W$ be a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme on which $\ell$ is invertible. For $E\in\mathsf{FinExt}_\ell$, write $A=\mathcal O_E$ and choose its uniformizer $\varpi_E$ as in [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and use its completed coefficient sheaf $A_W$ and derived category of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Let $\mathcal B_E(W)$ be the full subcategory of $D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_W))$ of derived $(\varpi_E)$-complete objects, in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion]. Define
$$
 \mathcal R_E(W)=\mathcal B_E(W)[1/\varpi_E],\qquad
 \mathcal C_E(W)=D_{\mathrm{comp}}(W,E)=\Kar(\mathcal R_E(W)),
$$
using raw scalar localization [def-weil-linear-scalar-localization] and the Karoubi envelope [def-weil-karoubi-envelope]. Thus objects of $\mathcal R_E$ are complete integral objects and $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal R_E}(K,L)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal B_E}(K,L)\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}E$; objects of $\mathcal C_E$ are $(K,p)$ with $p^2=p$ in this localized Hom group. The notation $D_{\mathrm{comp}}(W,E)$ in this definition denotes $\mathcal C_E(W)$. When a finite-stage theorem instead uses the raw ambient rationalization, that category is $\mathcal R_E(W)$; its maps are included here by $K\mapsto(K,1_K)$ and $u\mapsto u$. No equivalence of $\mathcal R_E(W)$ with its Karoubi envelope is assumed.

Let $\mathcal B^c_E(W)=\Dbc(W_{\Proet},\mathcal O_E)$ be the full integral subcategory of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], and write
$$
 \mathcal R^c_E(W)=\mathcal B^c_E(W)[1/\varpi_E],\qquad
 \mathcal C^c_E(W)=\Dbc^{\mathrm{Kar}}(W,E)=\Kar(\mathcal R^c_E(W)).
$$
Here $\mathcal R^c_E(W)$ is exactly the raw rational category of [def-weil-pbc-rational-category]; $\Dbc^{\mathrm{Kar}}(W,E)$ denotes the constructible category called $\Dbc(W,E)$ in sketch32, lines 1204–1207. In particular, its objects are all $(K,p)$ with $K\in\mathcal B^c_E(W)$ and $p^2=p$ in the localized endomorphism group. In either $\mathcal C_E(W)$ or $\mathcal C^c_E(W)$ an arrow $(K,p)\to(L,q)$ is a localized arrow $u$ with $u=q\circ u\circ p$, its identity is $p$, and composition is the underlying localized composition [def-weil-karoubi-envelope]. The integral full-subcategory inclusion $j_E:\mathcal B^c_E(W)\to\mathcal B_E(W)$ gives the raw localized functor $j_E^{\mathrm{rat}}:\mathcal R^c_E(W)\to\mathcal R_E(W)$, on arrows
$$j_E^{\mathrm{rat}}\left(\sum_i u_i\otimes c_i\right)=\sum_i j_E(u_i)\otimes c_i.$$
Define the finite-stage constructible inclusion by
$$J_E:\mathcal C^c_E(W)\longrightarrow\mathcal C_E(W),\qquad
 (K,p)\longmapsto(j_EK,j_E^{\mathrm{rat}}(p)),\qquad
 u\longmapsto j_E^{\mathrm{rat}}(u).$$

For $E\subset F$, use the ambient integral scalar-extension functor $C_{F/E,W}$ and its constructible restriction from [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]. On raw localized arrows send $u\otimes c$ to $C_{F/E,W}(u)\otimes c$, with $c\in E\subset F$. On Karoubi objects send $(K,p)$ to $(C_{F/E,W}K,C_{F/E,W}^{\mathrm{rat}}(p))$, and on Karoubi arrows use that localized map. This defines transitions $T^{\mathrm{amb},W}_{F/E}$ on $\mathcal C_E(W)$ and $T^{c,W}_{F/E}$ on $\mathcal C^c_E(W)$. The notation $T^W_{F/E}$ for an ambient transition means $T^{\mathrm{amb},W}_{F/E}$. Normalize the identity transitions literally to the identity. Use the tensor associators $a^s_{G,F,E}:T^{s,W}_{G/F}T^{s,W}_{F/E}\xrightarrow{\sim}T^{s,W}_{G/E}$ for $s\in\{\mathrm{amb},c\}$, extended from the integral data by localization and Karoubi extension. The scalar-extension comparisons with the full-subcategory inclusions give coherent natural isomorphisms
$$b_{F/E}:T^{\mathrm{amb},W}_{F/E}J_E\xrightarrow{\sim}J_FT^{c,W}_{F/E}.$$
They are the identity on the common underlying integral tensor construction before extension. On a Karoubi object $(K,p)$, a comparison $\theta:H\xrightarrow{\sim}H'$ is extended with component $H'(p)\circ\theta_K\circ H(p)$ and inverse $H(p)\circ\theta_K^{-1}\circ H'(p)$. Use these components for $a^s$ and $b$; their unit and tower equations are the inherited scalar-extension equations of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension].

For each $s\in\{\mathrm{amb},c\}$, prescribe $\mathcal P^s_W$ by objects $(E,K)$ with $K\in\mathcal C^s_E(W)$, where $\mathcal C^{\mathrm{amb}}_E(W)=\mathcal C_E(W)$. A morphism $(E,K)\to(F,L)$ is a class $[M,u]$, with $M\supset E,F$ a finite coefficient field and $u:T^{s,W}_{M/E}K\to T^{s,W}_{M/F}L$. For $N\supset M$ put
$$u_N=a^s_{N,M,F,L}\circ T^{s,W}_{N/M}(u)\circ(a^s_{N,M,E,K})^{-1}.$$
Two representatives are identified when their transported arrows agree at some further finite overfield. The identity is $[E,1_K]$; addition and composition are computed at a common finite overfield. Take the additive pair categories supplied by [lem-sbc-coherent-pair-functor-descent] for these coherent data, and define
$$
 D_{\mathrm{comp}}(W,\Qlb)=\Kar(\mathcal P^{\mathrm{amb}}_W),\qquad
 \Dbc^{\mathrm{Kar}}(W,\Qlb)=\Kar(\mathcal P^c_W).
$$
The latter is the constructible category called $\Dbc(W,\Qlb)$ in sketch32, lines 1419–1422: its general object is $((E,(K,p)),e)$, where $(K,p)\in\mathcal C^c_E(W)$ and $e^2=e$ in the pair-category endomorphism group. Its arrows $v:(P,e)\to(Q,d)$ satisfy $v=d\circ v\circ e$, and its identity is $e$. These definitions keep both the finite-stage and outer Karoubi envelopes explicitly.

Define $J_{\mathrm{pair}}:\mathcal P^c_W\to\mathcal P^{\mathrm{amb}}_W$ by the coherent-pair functor construction of [lem-sbc-coherent-pair-functor-descent]:
$$J_{\mathrm{pair}}(E,K)=(E,J_EK),\qquad
 J_{\mathrm{pair}}[M,u]=[M,b_{M/F,L}^{-1}\circ J_M(u)\circ b_{M/E,K}].$$
The constructible-to-ambient inclusion on the full source categories is its Karoubi extension
$$
 J_{\Qlb}:\Dbc^{\mathrm{Kar}}(W,\Qlb)\longrightarrow D_{\mathrm{comp}}(W,\Qlb),\qquad
 (P,e)\longmapsto(J_{\mathrm{pair}}P,J_{\mathrm{pair}}e),\qquad
 v\longmapsto J_{\mathrm{pair}}v.
$$
In particular, $((E,(K,p)),e)$ is sent to $((E,(j_EK,j_E^{\mathrm{rat}}p)),J_{\mathrm{pair}}e)$, with neither idempotent replaced by an identity. The raw finite-stage categories of [def-weil-pbc-rational-category] map into these categories by the identity-idempotent inclusions; the raw Qbar pair category of [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category] maps in by first applying those finite-stage inclusions and then the outer identity-idempotent inclusion. These maps on raw objects are restrictions of the stated construction, not identifications of the raw categories with the source's Karoubi envelopes. The ambient categories impose no constructible bounds on their objects.
